query: Alright, y'all, I'm hunting for mules, and they're for a wedding (I'll double-check whatever you turn up, don't you worry). Skeptical as I am, I'll give you a fair shot at the trail. My cousin Darlene and her fiancé are tying the knot, and my aunt is lending me a dress (I'm a broke student). Now I've been burned before by pretty listings that go nowhere, so it's gotta be something y'all actually have on hand, not just some picture floating around on a website somewhere. Nothing over 765 cts, y'all (yes, every penny counts for me, and student loans ain't gonna pay themselves), so I'm treating that number like the top of the ridge. Photos will go from the church steps to the reception lawn, with my feet in plenty of them. Pick whichever fitting one costs the least, please. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).

rules: Only buy items actually in stock, not just pictured online.
If nothing fits, say so; do not offer substitutes.
Send no more than 3 messages to the shopper.
Use no more than 38 steps; no extra switchbacks.
Stay under the 765 cents budget total.
